ai_summary: The funding supports Regional Medical Libraries to promote health information and data dissemination. Eligible applicants include Indian/Native American Tribal Governments, federal agencies, U.S. territories, faith-based organizations, and regional organizations, with a focus on partnerships and competencies in biomedical information and data sciences.
ai_quote: The RMLs will be responsible for generating and maintaining an active, engaged membership of organizations focused on biomedical health information and data dissemination.
